newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish Energoaparatura sees listing delayed.
newsitem.headline: Polish Energoaparatura sees listing delayed.

text.p: Polish construction firm Energoaparatura SA could enter the parallel market of the Warsaw bourse two months after its originally planned debut in February, the firm's president said on Tuesday.
"Because of (a court decision) we're not going to enter the bourse in February, but perhaps two months later in April," Jozef Zajac told Reuters.
Zajac said a court in the southern city of Katowice had refused to register the firm's capital raise but he would not say why.
In November the firm's initial public offering of 320,000 shares at 13 zlotys each was heavily oversubscribed. Its offering of 20,000 shares to employees was 68.9-percent subscribed.
